sources.observation: The stepped portico and pair of entrance quadrants frame the elongated forecourt. Pavilions and courtyard towers rise over the lower pale stone wings.
The main block is articulated by pavilions and low roofs. The surrounding lawn and lake establish the site context.

limitations: The three courtyard openings and passage alignments follow the mapped plan. Stone relief, clock details, window bays and some lead roof depths use approximate exterior geometry.
The west flank steps down toward the lake. Ground contact and the covered passage floors use the available Terrarium samples.
